title: A JSON array decodes into a `#[Core\Json\Derive]` class as an object with no keys.
text: `Core\Json::decodeAs<A>("[1]")` for a class with a `string $city` field throws one issue, `city: required field missing`, where a number or `null` at the same place gives `a \`A\` decodes from a JSON object` with an empty path. The decoder's object test is `document.array_ptr()`, and a decoded JSON list is an array too, so a list passes it and is walked as a map with integer keys. A field renamed with `#[Core\Json\Field(name: "0")]` is filled from a list: `decodeAs<A>("[\"paris\"]")` builds an `A` whose field is `paris`. It closes when a JSON list where an object is expected gives the object issue, with a conformance case.
